description: Fetch one station's 1991–2020 U.S. Climate Normals, NOAA's current 30-year baseline, for comparing an observed day, month, season, or year against normal. Covers monthly, daily, hourly, and annual/seasonal normals of temperature, precipitation, snowfall, degree days, and the other NCEI normals elements, and needs no token. noaa_climate_fetch_data's NORMAL_* datasets are the superseded 1981–2010 normals. stationId is a GHCN-Daily ID such as USW00024233; about 15,600 stations carry monthly, daily, and annual/seasonal normals, about 470 (nearly all USW stations) hourly normals, and precipitation-only stations carry no temperature normals. Values stay in NCEI's native units — °F, inches, °F-days, hPa — and are never converted; a record carries its unit wherever that unit was verified. Each record carries NCEI's completeness flag and the years of data behind it: S is standard, while R, P, and E mark normals built from fewer years or estimated from neighboring stations. A -9999 value comes back as missing=true with no value. An unknown station and a station without normals both return no records.

datatypeId.description: Normals datatype IDs to read (1–50), uppercased before sending. Each must carry the granularity's prefix: MLY- for monthly; DLY-, MTD- (month-to-date), or YTD- (year-to-date) for daily; HLY- for hourly; ANN-, DJF-, MAM-, JJA-, or SON- for annualseasonal. Omitted, monthly reads MLY-TAVG-NORMAL, MLY-TMAX-NORMAL, MLY-TMIN-NORMAL, MLY-PRCP-NORMAL, and MLY-SNOW-NORMAL; annualseasonal the same five with ANN-; daily DLY-TAVG-NORMAL, DLY-TMAX-NORMAL, and DLY-TMIN-NORMAL; hourly HLY-TEMP-NORMAL and HLY-DEWP-NORMAL. NCEI's documentation for each product lists the rest — degree days such as MLY-HTDD-NORMAL, standard deviations, percentiles, and frost dates.

granularity.description: Which normals product to read: monthly (rows "01"–"12"), daily (rows "01-01"–"12-31", including "02-29"), hourly (rows "01-01T00:00:00"–"12-31T23:00:00" in local standard time; month required), or annualseasonal (one row with no date — the period is the datatype prefix: ANN annual, DJF/MAM/JJA/SON seasons).

limit.description: Maximum records per page; a record is one datatype on one row. Defaults to 100, which holds the monthly defaults (60 records) or one month of daily defaults (up to 93). Larger positive integers are clamped to 1000 with a notice unless NOAA_CLAMP_LIMITS=false.

month.description: Month 1–12. Required for hourly, which is read one month at a time (744 rows per datatype for January). Narrows daily to that month’s days — February includes 02-29 — and monthly to that month. Rejected for annualseasonal, which has no month axis.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return. Defaults to 0.

stationId.description: GHCN-Daily station to read, one per call (e.g., "USW00024233", Seattle-Tacoma International Airport). Find IDs with noaa_climate_find_stations; confirm one with noaa_climate_get_station. Trims surrounding whitespace, strips a GHCND: prefix (GHCND:USW00024233 → USW00024233), and uppercases an ID written all in lowercase. IDs are matched case-sensitively, so a mixed-case legacy ID such as US10adam002 is sent as written.

name: noaa_climate_get_normals

cap.description: The limit that was applied. Omitted otherwise.

effectiveQuery.description: The NCEI dataset, station, datatypes, and month that were requested.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `validation_error`: A datatypeId lacks the granularity’s prefix, month is missing for hourly or given for annualseasonal, or the NCEI Access Data Service rejected a parameter. `service_unavailable`: The NCEI Access Data Service is unreachable, returned a server error other than a 504, or answered with something other than JSON rows. A 504 and a request that times out, the 45-second call deadline included, fail as Timeout with no declared reason instead. `rate_limited`: The NCEI Access Data Service throttled the request (HTTP 429). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

exhausted.description: True when offset is past the end of a non-empty response — the page is empty but records exist. Omitted otherwise.

granularity.description: The normals product that was read.

notice.description: Composed guidance: station ID normalization, limit clamping, missing values and non-standard completeness on this page, requested datatypes no row carries, unlabeled units, no records, and paging. Omitted when none applies.

results.description: Normals records ordered by date, then by requested datatype.

completeness.description: NCEI completeness flag: S standard (24 or more years), R representative (10 or more years, gaps filled from nearby stations), P provisional (10 or more years, gaps unfilled), E estimated from nearby stations (2 or more years). Omitted when blank.

date.description: NCEI’s row key with no year: "01" monthly, "01-31" daily, "01-01T00:00:00" hourly in local standard time. Omitted for annualseasonal.

measurementFlag.description: NCEI measurement flag: M missing, V year-round frost-freeze risk, X nonzero value rounded to zero, Y too few values to compute, Z computed value inconsistent with others. Omitted when blank.

missing.description: True when NCEI reports its -9999 special value — the normal is missing or could not be computed; value is omitted.

unit.description: Native unit: °F for temperature and dew point normals, in for precipitation and snowfall normals (monthly, seasonal, annual, month-to-date, year-to-date), °F-days for base-65 heating and cooling degree days (monthly, daily, seasonal, and annual -HTDD-NORMAL and -CLDD-NORMAL), hPa for hourly sea-level pressure (HLY-PRES-NORMAL, HLY-PRES-10PCTL, HLY-PRES-90PCTL; NCEI’s documentation says inches of mercury, but the values are hPa). Omitted for every other datatype, degree days at other bases included; the notice links NCEI’s documentation for its unit.

value.description: The normal in its native unit. Omitted when missing is true, and when NCEI writes the value as text (valueText).

valueText.description: A value NCEI writes as text rather than a number: the MM/DD dates of the annual frost and freeze probability normals (ANN-TMIN-PRBFST-*, ANN-TMIN-PRBLST-*). Omitted otherwise.

years.description: Years of data behind the value. Omitted when NCEI leaves it blank.

shown.description: Records returned on this page. Omitted otherwise.

station.description: The bare GHCN-Daily station ID that was read.

totalCount.description: Records in the whole response, before offset and limit.

truncated.description: True when more records exist beyond this page. Omitted otherwise.

title: Get NOAA 1991–2020 Climate Normals
